attempted_claim: Let d>=2 and let T_1,T_2,T_3 be weakly mixing measure-preserving Z^d-actions on standard probability spaces, each with purely singular maximal spectral type (singular with respect to Haar measure on the dual group T^d). Is every pairwise independent joining lambda in J(T_1,T_2,T_3) necessarily the product measure?
decisive_failure: No complete proof or disproof of the Z^d joining-rigidity target was obtained within the bounded clock. Route A failed at an explicit F. and M. Riesz obstruction on T^d; Route B (Ledrappier) was excluded by the singular-spectrum hypothesis; Route C produced no singular dependent-triple model. The directional-projection corollary was judged a routine consequence of known work with no independent Audit value, so no emergent finding is claimed.
